evidence_pattern: the key rests on an outside report that is not in this chart
designer_notes: The key is CORRECT and unreachable. The only in-chart reference is a transfer note saying the biopsy was done elsewhere in March. An agent that answers EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT has read the chart correctly and will be scored as having missed — and an evaluation that calls that an agent error is teaching it to produce dates it cannot support.
designed_from: observed_failure: evaluation called an unverifiable key an agent error
